reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface plugin that adds a right-side question timeline for previewing and navigating messages in the current conversation using existing browser session snapshots.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 当前会话添加右侧提问时间线，支持悬停预览提问并点击跳转到对应消息。
summaries.en: Adds a right-side question timeline to the current DeepSeek Harness conversation for hovering previews and clicking to jump to messages.

capabilities: Reads existing browser session snapshots for user messages and timestamps
Adds an in-session timeline interface with hover previews
Navigates to conversation messages by scrolling the current page
Injects interface styles and adapts to light and dark themes
